p2c1.caption: I go new ways, a new speech has come to me…
p2c1.rationale: Storm-dream converts to storm-joy; mirror-grin + lightning + lioness eyes.
p2c1.title: The Child with the Mirror

p2c10.caption: Do not cease your dance, sweet girls!
p2c10.rationale: A dance that fails: round over sadness; Life's gold fishing-rod is the lure.
p2c10.title: The Dance Song

p2c11.caption: …only where there are graves are there resurrections.
p2c11.rationale: Grief-voyage to the grave-island; the Will breaks graves — proleptic resurrection.
p2c11.title: The Funeral Song

p2c12.caption: …I am that which must overcome itself again and again.
p2c12.rationale: Will-to-power: river, mirror, dice, egg in one vertical stack.
p2c12.title: Of Self-Overcoming

p2c13.caption: Still is the bottom of my sea: who could guess that it hides sportive monsters!
p2c13.rationale: Pillar-virtue judges tiger-tension, ox-earth, thorns without a rose.
p2c13.title: Of the Sublime Men

p2c14.caption: So now I love only my children’s land, the undiscovered land in the furthest sea…
p2c14.rationale: Five motley masks + escaping sails: scorn of the masquerade, love of the future.
p2c14.title: Of the Land of Culture

p2c15.caption: All sun-love is innocence and creative desire!
p2c15.rationale: Moon lechery converted to solar innocence across a dawn-blade diptych.
p2c15.title: Of Immaculate Perception

p2c16.caption: I have left the house of scholars and slammed the door behind me.
p2c16.rationale: Slam + flight: impact-rays, bitten wreath, poppy-ground; the cohort's smallest art.
p2c16.title: Of Scholars

p2c17.caption: …is the sea not the peacock of peacocks?
p2c17.rationale: Sea/peacock vanity: wave-feather bravura + buffalo + dredged god-head; no earnest lyre.
p2c17.title: Of Poets

p2c18.caption: The greatest events – they are not our noisiest but our stillest hours.
p2c18.rationale: Bellow vs stillness: cut-away volcano reveals the earth's gold heart — last gold.
p2c18.title: Of Great Events

p2c19.caption: Everything is empty, everything is one, everything is past!
p2c19.rationale: The burst: grave-fortress torn open, thousand-peal motley laughter canopy.
p2c19.title: The Prophet

p2c2.caption: The beauty of the Superman came to me as a shadow.
p2c2.rationale: Harvest sermon; split fig + gold seeds + hammer; part's only early gold.
p2c2.title: On the Blissful Islands

p2c20.caption: …until the creative will says to it: ‘But I willed it thus!’
p2c20.rationale: Bridge-dialogue: giant ear on a man-stalk over fragments; the redemption formula.
p2c20.title: Of Redemption

p2c21.caption: It is not the height, it is the abyss that is terrible!
p2c21.rationale: Vertical abyss cleft: eye-up, hand-down, dragon's eye below; corona-less night.
p2c21.title: Of Manly Prudence

p2c22.caption: It is the stillest words which bring the storm.
p2c22.rationale: Voiceless command; still clock, dove-trail, dew, dawn-break sliver.
p2c22.title: The Stillest Hour

p2c3.caption: Shame, shame, shame – that is the history of man!
p2c3.rationale: Pity made furniture: iron camp-bed, hard blanket, red disc half-hidden.
p2c3.title: Of the Compassionate

p2c4.caption: …pass them by quietly and with sleeping swords!
p2c4.rationale: Sleeping swords over a sleeping beast over a poison pool; one poppy promises rupture.
p2c4.title: Of the Priests

p2c5.caption: You want to be paid as well, you virtuous!
p2c5.rationale: Left-to-right argument: ploughshare tears, menagerie mocks, shells console.
p2c5.title: Of the Virtuous

p2c6.caption: Life is a fountain of delight; but where the rabble also drinks all wells are poisoned.
p2c6.rationale: Disgust below, purity above, wind between; grins rhyme with the devil's.
p2c6.title: Of the Rabble

p2c7.caption: …that is the bridge to my highest hope and a rainbow after protracted storms.
p2c7.rationale: Web/pillar/rainbow: venom diagnosed, equality unmasked, self bound against revenge.
p2c7.title: Of the Tarantulas

p2c8.caption: Like a sail, shuddering before the impetuosity of the spirit, my wisdom fares over the sea…
p2c8.rationale: Sail above, desert below; the empty lion-skin is fame's costume with nobody in it.
p2c8.title: Of the Famous Philosophers

p2c9.caption: Light am I: ah, that I were night!
p2c9.rationale: Giver's solitude at totality; rising-only arcs; ring-form refrains crowned.
p2c9.title: The Night Song
